results.title: What Balendra Shah can learn from Zohran Mamdani
results.content: Nepal’s prime minister and New York City mayor both rode the same anti-establishment wave. But only one of them takes tough questions.

results.title: Dhangadhi FC partners with Kathmandu Sports Development Ventures to form Sudurpashchim Sports Ventures
results.content: The new joint venture, chaired by Upendra Mahoto, aims to expand into football, grassroots development, and women's sports.

results.title: Police barge into newsrooms of Naya Patrika and Diyo Post looking for journalists
results.content: Plainclothes officers went to the offices of two media outlets seeking five journalists, while Nepal Press journo Bishwamani Subedi has already been taken to the Cyber Bureau for questioning.

results.title: Journalist Bishwamani Subedi taken into police custody from newsroom
results.content: Plainclothes officers took the Nepal Press journalist from his workplace on Friday and were bringing him to the Cyber Bureau for questioning, an official said.

results.title: Nepal seeks recognition for six more 8,000-metre peaks
results.content: The proposal would increase the number of internationally recognised peaks above 8,000 metres in Nepal from eight to 14, giving the country 14 of the world's 20 highest mountains.

results.title: Explained: The leaked WhatsApp chats that have shaken Nepal’s judiciary
results.content: The messages between Justice Hari Prasad Phuyal and Inam Sapkota, an alleged fixer, have put the top court’s credibility in question. Here is what they reveal, what Phuyal says and why the fallout reaches the chief justice.

results.title: Cyclone Arnab’s impact on Nepal to ease from Saturday afternoon
results.content: Rain and snowfall are expected across much of the country on Friday, with heavy precipitation possible in some areas overnight.

results.title: UN extends Nepal’s LDC graduation preparatory period until November 2029
results.content: Nepal and Bangladesh have been given three more years to strengthen their economies and prepare for the loss of trade preferences and other support available to least developed countries.

results.title: Japan cites privacy in withholding details on Nepal’s envoy nominee
results.content: The parliamentary hearing committee is seeking clarification on Jigyan Kumar Thapa’s Japanese permanent residency and possible links to government-funded institutions, but Tokyo says it cannot disclose personal information.

results.title: Nepal plans temporary bridges to reopen flood-hit Rasuwagadhi border crossing
results.content: Authorities aim to restore road access to the Chinese border before rebuilding permanently, while also considering an expressway to Kerung in place of a proposed railway.

results.title: Nepal’s government needs to vet public appointments before announcing them
results.content: From Lumbini to the diplomatic corps, picks are being made before hard questions are asked.

results.title: PM Shah floated the idea of Nepal-India-China cooperation on climate. Why is the government slow to reach out to the neighbours?
results.content: Nepal’s foreign and environment ministries are working on a proposal to be sent to the two neighbours. Beijing has signalled openness to sharing climate data while Delhi has signed up to a regional mechanism.

results.title: Nepal Police command meets for hours amid fears of IG sacking
results.content: The government is reportedly unhappy with IG Karki’s stance on following the due process while making big arrests.

results.title: ‘Rahul, Rahul, Rahul’: Janakpur’s 16-year-old pacer is the NPL’s newest sensation
results.content: The talent-hunt find took four wickets against Kathmandu Gorkhas, striking with the first ball of two separate overs, and the stadium has already adopted him.

results.title: Small countries must defend multilateral trade system, says WTO chief
results.content: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala urges developing economies, including Nepal, to push for reforms and use WTO tools to help local businesses access global markets.

results.title: Foreign enrolment remains a hard sell for Nepali medical colleges
results.content: Nepal reserves 33 percent of medical education seats for foreign students, but only 746 enrolled last year.

results.title: Indian foreign secretary, new ambassador to arrive in Kathmandu ahead of Shah’s India visit
results.content: Vikram Misri is scheduled to arrive on November 4 to discuss the agenda for the prime minister’s expected visit to New Delhi, likely on November 22, while Sudhakar Dalela arrives a day earlier to take up his diplomatic assignment.
